_comment: S38.12 — Budget exception'lari. HAR bir exception uchun owner + expires (ISO date) + justification + measured qiymat MAJBURIY. Exception'lar asoslanmagan bo'lsa budget gate fail bo'ladi. Bu fayl EXAMPLE — ishlatish uchun performance-budget.exceptions.json ga ko'chiring.
